scope: Complete canonical manuscript, canonical BibTeX database, generated bibliography/auxiliary state, and the ancillary verifier were audited. Four primary records and the exact passages supporting all nine citation-bearing claims were checked; user-library selection and broader primary-literature coverage were also audited.
citation_audit_method: Two-stage non-interactive search-mode audit: freeze every claim/citation pair in a digest-bound ledger, then independently verify bibliographic identity, current version, and exact passage-level support against primary records/full text; mechanically compare body-flow, BibTeX, auxiliary, and ledger key sets.
